name: Boston University Central
story: The B branch stops on Commonwealth Avenue beside Marsh Chapel. Head behind the chapel and the campus opens toward the Charles River.

name: Kenmore
story: Three Green Line branches meet here. The Citgo sign marks the square, and the streets south of it lead to Fenway Park.

name: Copley
story: Come out onto Boylston Street between the Central Library and Copley Square, with Newbury Street and the Commonwealth Avenue Mall a few blocks away.

name: Park Street
story: The Red and Green lines meet at the corner of Boston Common. Start on Tremont Street or cut through the Common toward the Public Garden.

name: Government Center
story: The Blue and Green lines meet next to City Hall Plaza. Walk downhill toward Faneuil Hall and the market buildings.

name: Haymarket
story: Step out near Boston Public Market and cross the Greenway to reach the North End. You can go from a market snack to North Square in one short walk.

name: Harvard
story: Step out into Harvard Square, where Massachusetts Avenue meets the brick gates of Harvard Yard. Independent shops and university museums are a short walk away.

name: Central
story: Central puts you on Massachusetts Avenue between Cambridgeport and The Port. Look for murals along Mass Ave or detour down Pearl Street.

name: Chinatown
story: Leave the Orange Line at Washington and Boylston. Follow the neighborhood streets toward the Beach Street gate and the southern end of the Greenway.
